scope: Design data consistency only; game systems and playtests are not implemented or tested by this script.

checks.name: Scope: no meta progression, currency or attachments
Item schema and finite numerical values
Weapons: four fixed tiers and exact formulas
Starting presets: Q1, valid references, 5/12 capacity
Map and contract references, authored graph connectivity
Loot weights, boss and event budgets
Backlog dependencies are valid and acyclic
Readable catalog covers each item once
Document package local links and expected files
